purpose: Finite-slip slab/truss panel, deformable supports and explicit first local limits. No imposed global collapse and no change to V11A/V11B or Blender.

panel.slab_model: Axial compression-only scalar DOF per top station; co-located with steel top chord, no slab flexure, tension or eccentricity. Vertical attachment is perfect and NOT rupture-capable in V11C.
panel.kinematics: Small displacements; original geometry and directions retained. No catenary, geometric stiffness, postbuckling, creep or dynamics.
panel.knuckle_density_status: 713/16 in hypothetical equivalent density, not a transcribed count. Two trusses times tributary length/spacing; half station weights at ends. Total 32 equivalent knuckles per pair, not an as-built inventory.
panel.seat_detail_status: Explicit representative alternatives, NOT assigned to an actual floor seat. Validate IDs against cached table before use.
panel.support_stiffness_status: UNMEASURED_LINEAR_SPRING_HYPOTHESES; zero at right x means true roller, no penalty stiffness

bond.stiffness_and_strength_factors_status: Uncalibrated sensitivity; reduced strength does not stand for computed aircraft damage and does not also reduce stiffness.
bond.failure_rule: Linear elastic to shear limit, then remove horizontal bond only in a separately labelled same-load quasistatic diagnostic. No measured ductility, softening or fracture energy; no dynamic continuation.
bond.source: NIST NCSTAR 1-6C, printed p67 Table5-7 / local PDF115
bond.thermal_index: CONCRETE temperature, NOT steel or gas temperature; interpolation between published values is our model assumption; no extrapolation

cold_paths.status: 18 predetermined stiffness/strength/support combinations; stop at earliest nominal member, slab, bond or seat limit, not at desired historical outcome

thermal_paths_status: Prescribed monotone parameter paths AFTER a separately checked cold gravity preload; not seconds, compartment fire or actual temperature history. Any first nominal limit ends the path.

source_pdf_review.purpose: Read bounded knuckle analysis and limits; no full-source or archive scan
